# METHOD. Composita of small-degree number fields: 24 = 2*12 = 3*8 = 4*6 = 2*2*6 = 2*3*4.
# Minimal polynomial of alpha+beta via Res_y(f(y), g(x-y)); triples by iterated resultant.
# Every field so built contains a proper subfield, so the Galois group is IMPRIMITIVE by
# construction - the region random sparse search does not reach (random polynomials land
# in S24/A24).
#
# DISTINCTNESS. Varying the primitive element generates the same field, so those are not
# separate submissions. Candidates were fingerprinted by factorization degree pattern mod
# the first 25 primes (equal for almost all p iff the fields agree) and only the smallest
# |poldisc| generator per fingerprint was kept. 754 constructions -> 587 distinct fields.
# Lines are ordered by ascending |poldisc|.
#
# NOT CLAIMED. No 24Tt label was computed locally (no Magma). This set was NOT filtered
# against the frozen LMFDB baseline, so an unknown fraction is already covered; the
# cyclotomic ones almost certainly are. Nothing here is asserted to be new.
#
# Annotations after '#' are the construction and the mod-p cycle-type spectrum, for
# provenance only. They are comments and do not affect verification.
